name: Bernoulli
signature: Single-trial binary distribution with parameter p; the base case of the binomial family.

name: Rademacher
signature: Symmetric two-point distribution used as a sign-flip variable, distinguishing it from Bernoulli's {0,1} support.
known_ml_uses: Hutchinson trace estimator for Hessian-vector products

name: Binomial
signature: Sum of n iid Bernoulli trials; distinguished from Poisson binomial by requiring identical success probabilities.
known_ml_uses: modeling count data with fixed trials
A/B testing statistics for model evaluation

name: Beta-binomial
signature: Binomial with success probability marginalized over a Beta prior, giving overdispersion relative to plain binomial.
known_ml_uses: Bayesian hierarchical models for click-through/count data
overdispersed count modeling in Bayesian deep learning

name: Degenerate
signature: All probability mass on a single value; zero entropy, the deterministic limiting case of any distribution.

name: Discrete uniform
support: finite set of equally likely values
signature: Maximum entropy distribution over a finite support with no other constraints, all outcomes equiprobable.

name: Hypergeometric
signature: Models draws without replacement from a finite population, unlike binomial's with-replacement assumption.
known_ml_uses: survey/finite-population statistics used in evaluation set design

name: Negative hypergeometric
support: non-negative integers up to population limit
signature: Counts draws without replacement needed to reach a fixed number of successes, the without-replacement analogue of negative binomial.

name: Poisson binomial
signature: Sum of independent Bernoulli trials with distinct success probabilities, generalizing binomial to heterogeneous trials.

name: Fisher's noncentral hypergeometric
support: bounded integer range dependent on population sizes
signature: Hypergeometric distribution biased by an odds-ratio weight on each ball's inclusion, arising from independent binomial-type sampling conditioned on totals.

name: Wallenius' noncentral hypergeometric
support: bounded integer range dependent on population sizes
signature: Biased hypergeometric distribution arising from sequential weighted sampling without replacement, distinguishing it from Fisher's non-sequential formulation.
known_ml_uses: biased sampling-without-replacement models for weighted subset selection

name: Benford's law
signature: Logarithmic first-digit distribution P(d)=log10(1+1/d), an empirical scale-invariance law rather than a derived exponential-family model.
known_ml_uses: data integrity checks for training data auditing

name: Zipf's law
signature: Power-law probability mass proportional to rank^-s over a finite ranked support, capturing rank-frequency scaling.

name: Zipf-Mandelbrot
signature: Generalizes Zipf's law with an additional shift parameter q, giving mass proportional to (rank+q)^-s, fitting corpora better at low ranks.

name: Beta negative binomial
signature: Negative binomial with success probability marginalized over a Beta prior, producing a heavier-tailed compound count distribution with three free parameters.
known_ml_uses: overdispersed count modeling in Bayesian hierarchical models

name: Boltzmann
signature: Probability of a state decays exponentially with its energy divided by temperature, the maximum-entropy distribution given fixed mean energy.

name: Maxwell-Boltzmann
support: non-negative reals (speed) — listed under discrete infinite but continuous in physics
signature: Distribution of particle speeds derived from Gaussian velocity components, giving a chi-distribution-like shape with a specific quadratic-times-exponential density.

name: Borel
signature: Arises as the distribution of total progeny in a Poisson branching (queueing busy-period) process, parameterized by a single offspring-mean parameter.

name: Discrete phase-type
signature: Distribution of the number of steps until absorption in a finite discrete-time Markov chain, defined via a sub-stochastic transition matrix rather than a closed-form pmf.

name: Extended negative binomial
signature: Generalizes the negative binomial with an extra parameter allowing sub-negative-binomial dispersion patterns not reachable by the classical two-parameter form.

name: Generalized log-series
signature: Extends the logarithmic series distribution with an added shape parameter, altering tail decay while keeping the log-series's decreasing pmf structure.

name: Gauss-Kuzmin
signature: Gives the limiting distribution of partial-quotient digits in continued fraction expansions of random reals, with pmf decaying like 1/k^2.

name: Geometric
signature: Discrete analogue of the exponential distribution, uniquely characterized by the memoryless property among discrete distributions.

name: Hermite
signature: Sum of two independent Poisson variables with different rates, giving two-parameter flexibility beyond simple Poisson variance-mean equality.

name: Logarithmic
signature: Probability mass proportional to p^k/k, arising as the limiting distribution of positive Poisson-stopped or negative binomial counts as size parameter tends to zero.

name: Mixed Poisson
signature: General family formed by mixing a Poisson rate parameter over an arbitrary mixing distribution, producing overdispersion relative to plain Poisson.

name: Negative binomial
signature: Gamma-Poisson mixture giving a closed-form count distribution with variance exceeding the mean, unlike Poisson's equality of mean and variance.
known_ml_uses: negative binomial loss for count data in deep learning

name: Compound Poisson
support: non-negative integers or reals depending on jump distribution
signature: Sum of a Poisson-distributed number of i.i.d. jump variables, making it infinitely divisible and generalizing simple Poisson counts to random cluster sizes.

name: Parabolic fractal
signature: A specialized discrete count law defined via a parabolic fractal-dimension generating structure, distinguishing it from standard power-law count distributions.

name: Poisson
signature: Single-parameter count distribution where mean equals variance, arising as the limit of binomial trials with vanishing success probability and fixed expectation.

name: Displaced Poisson
support: integers greater than or equal to a fixed shift
signature: Ordinary Poisson distribution shifted by a fixed integer offset to enforce a minimum count, unlike standard Poisson which always includes zero.

name: Hyper-Poisson
signature: Generalizes Poisson via a confluent hypergeometric normalizing function, allowing both over- and under-dispersion controlled by an extra shape parameter.

name: General Poisson binomial
signature: Distribution of the sum of independent but non-identically distributed Bernoulli trials, generalizing the binomial to heterogeneous success probabilities.

name: Poisson type
signature: Umbrella term for discrete distributions satisfying a Poisson-like recursive probability ratio structure (power series/Katz family), not a single fixed law.

name: Conway-Maxwell-Poisson
signature: Adds a dispersion exponent to the Poisson pmf term k!^{-nu}, allowing continuous interpolation between under-, equi-, and over-dispersed counts, unlike fixed-dispersion Poisson.

name: Zero-truncated Poisson
signature: Poisson distribution conditioned on being strictly positive, removing the zero mass and renormalizing.
known_ml_uses: count-data modeling with structural zero exclusion

name: Polya-Eggenberger
signature: Urn-scheme distribution generating positive correlation between draws via reinforcement, generalizing binomial with overdispersion.
known_ml_uses: Chinese restaurant process / Polya urn analogies in Bayesian nonparametrics

name: Skellam
signature: Distribution of the difference of two independent Poisson random variables, symmetric-count analogue with support on all integers.
known_ml_uses: modeling difference of count data e.g. goal differences, sensor differences

name: Skew elliptical
signature: Family generalizing elliptical distributions (e.g. skew-normal, skew-t) by adding a skewness parameter that breaks symmetry while retaining elliptical contours as a limit.

name: Yule-Simon
signature: Discrete power-law distribution arising from preferential attachment processes, with tail exponent set by a single shape parameter.
known_ml_uses: modeling word frequency / preferential attachment in network growth models

name: Modified half-normal
signature: Generalization of the half-normal with an extra shape parameter modifying the density's polynomial prefactor, extending flexibility beyond the standard half-normal.

name: Zeta
signature: Discrete power-law distribution whose normalizing constant is the Riemann zeta function, a continuous-parameter special case related to Zipf's law.

name: Zipf
signature: Finite-support power-law distribution over ranks, with probability inversely proportional to rank raised to an exponent.

name: Hardy
signature: Discrete distribution generated from Hardy's series expansion (related to Bessel-type generating functions), used to model contagious/clustered count data.

name: Beta
signature: Two-parameter distribution on the unit interval that is the conjugate prior for the Bernoulli/binomial probability parameter.
known_ml_uses: VAE latent variable modeling with Beta priors

name: Four-parameter Beta
signature: Beta distribution generalized with location and scale parameters to support an arbitrary bounded interval [a,b] instead of [0,1].
known_ml_uses: bounded continuous variable modeling with custom ranges

name: Arcsine
signature: Special case of the Beta(1/2,1/2) distribution with U-shaped density concentrating mass near the boundaries 0 and 1.
known_ml_uses: random walk / arcsine law analysis in stochastic process theory

name: PERT
signature: Beta-derived distribution parameterised by min, mode, max with a fixed shape scaling to concentrate mass near the mode.
known_ml_uses: project/task duration modeling in simulation-based ML pipelines

name: Uniform
signature: Constant density over a finite interval, the maximum entropy distribution under only a support constraint.

name: Irwin-Hall
signature: Distribution of the sum of n independent standard uniform variables, converging to normal as n grows via CLT.
known_ml_uses: approximating Gaussian noise via sums of uniforms in early neural net implementations

name: Bates
signature: Mean of n independent uniform variables, a scaled Irwin-Hall distribution with variance shrinking as 1/n.
known_ml_uses: smoothed noise injection for regularization/data augmentation

name: Logit-normal
signature: Distribution obtained by applying the logistic sigmoid to a normal random variable, unlike Beta it has no simple closed-form moments.
known_ml_uses: variational autoencoders with bounded latent variables
modeling probabilities via Gaussian latent + sigmoid link

name: Dirac delta
signature: Degenerate distribution placing all probability mass at a single point, the limiting case of vanishing variance.
known_ml_uses: argmax/greedy decoding as degenerate sampling distribution
target labels in one-hot encoding viewed as delta on class

name: Kent
signature: Five-parameter distribution on the sphere generalizing von Mises-Fisher by allowing elliptical (anisotropic) contours.
known_ml_uses: directional statistics for embeddings on spheres

name: Kumaraswamy
signature: Beta-like distribution with closed-form CDF and quantile function, enabling exact inverse-transform sampling unlike Beta.

name: Logit metalog
signature: Metalog distribution family transformed via logit link to constrain support to (0,1), defined directly by quantile function fitted to data.

name: Marchenko-Pastur
support: bounded interval determined by aspect ratio
signature: Limiting spectral distribution of eigenvalues of large random covariance matrices, characterized by the aspect ratio parameter.
known_ml_uses: analyzing weight matrix spectra in deep learning
random matrix theory analysis of training dynamics and generalization
detecting signal vs noise eigenvalues in learned representations

name: Quantile-parameterized
support: bounded or unbounded interval depending on family
signature: Distribution family (e.g. metalog) defined directly by specifying quantiles rather than moments or density parameters.

name: Raised cosine
signature: Bounded distribution with cosine-shaped density that closely approximates the normal but has finite support and lighter tails.
known_ml_uses: signal processing windowing functions used in audio ML preprocessing

name: Reciprocal
signature: Density proportional to 1/x on [a,b], the maximum-entropy distribution for a fixed ratio scale (log-uniform).

name: Triangular
support: bounded interval [a, b] with mode c
signature: Piecewise-linear density defined by min, mode, and max with no free shape parameter beyond these three points.

name: Trapezoidal
support: bounded interval [a, d] with plateau [b, c]
signature: Generalizes the triangular distribution by having a flat top between two shoulders instead of a single mode.

name: Truncated normal
support: bounded interval [a, b] subset of reals
signature: Gaussian density restricted and renormalized to a finite interval, retaining log-concavity but altering moments via Mills-ratio corrections.

name: U-quadratic
signature: Symmetric quadratic density that is minimized at the interval midpoint, giving U-shaped mass concentrated near the endpoints.

name: Von Mises-Fisher
signature: Spherical analogue of the Gaussian, maximum-entropy on the sphere given a fixed mean direction and concentration parameter kappa.

name: Bingham
signature: Antipodally symmetric distribution on the sphere parameterized by a symmetric matrix, unlike vMF which has a single preferred direction.

name: Wigner semicircle
signature: Limiting spectral density of large random symmetric matrices (Wigner's theorem), a semicircular density unrelated to the Gaussian despite CLT-like origin.
known_ml_uses: theoretical analysis of neural network weight spectra
random matrix theory analyses of loss landscapes

name: Continuous Bernoulli
signature: Continuous analogue of the Bernoulli on the unit interval with a normalizing constant that is a function of the shape parameter lambda, introduced to correctly model pixel intensities in VAEs.
known_ml_uses: VAE pixel-intensity likelihood modeling (correcting Bernoulli misuse on [0,1] data)

name: Continuous binomial
signature: Extends the binomial's combinatorial coefficient to continuous count values via the Gamma function, allowing non-integer trial counts.

name: Henyey-Greenstein phase function
support: angular deflection [0, pi] / directional on sphere
signature: One-parameter empirical scattering phase function that approximates Mie scattering with a single asymmetry parameter g, without deriving from physical scattering theory.
known_ml_uses: differentiable volumetric rendering / neural rendering scattering models

name: Mie phase function
support: angular deflection [0, pi] / directional on sphere
signature: Exact physically-derived scattering phase function from Maxwell's equations for spherical particles, far more complex and multi-lobed than the empirical Henyey-Greenstein approximation.

name: Von Mises
signature: Circular analogue of the Gaussian: maximum-entropy distribution on the circle given fixed circular mean and concentration, with density involving modified Bessel function I0.
known_ml_uses: von Mises loss for angular outputs

name: Wrapped normal
signature: Obtained by wrapping a Gaussian around the circle via summation over all integer shifts, approximating the von Mises for small variance.

name: Wrapped exponential
signature: Wraps the exponential distribution around the circle, retaining a one-sided decaying density supported on a half-circle rather than symmetric like von Mises.

name: Wrapped Levy
signature: Wraps the heavy-tailed Levy distribution (a stable law with index 1/2) onto the circle, producing a skewed unimodal circular density.

name: Wrapped Cauchy
signature: Circular version of the Cauchy distribution with closed-form density via Poisson kernel, exhibiting heavier tails/peakedness than von Mises for the same concentration.

name: Wrapped Laplace
signature: Wraps the double-exponential (Laplace) distribution around the circle, giving a sharper peak and heavier tails than the wrapped normal.

name: Wrapped asymmetric Laplace
signature: Wraps the asymmetric Laplace distribution, adding a skewness parameter to the wrapped Laplace to model asymmetric circular data.

name: Dirac comb
support: discrete equally spaced points on real line or circle
signature: Not a probability distribution but a periodic sum of Dirac delta functions used to model discrete sampling grids.

name: Beta prime
signature: Ratio-of-betas distribution supported on the positive reals, obtained as the distribution of X/(1-X) when X is Beta-distributed, unlike the bounded Beta itself.

name: Birnbaum-Saunders
signature: Fatigue-life distribution derived from a transformation of the normal distribution modeling cumulative damage until failure, distinct from lognormal by its explicit crack-growth derivation.

name: Chi
signature: Distribution of the norm (square root of sum of squares) of k independent standard normals, distinguishing it from the chi-squared distribution of the sum itself.

name: Noncentral chi
signature: Generalizes the chi distribution to normals with nonzero means, with a noncentrality parameter shifting the distribution's mode away from zero.

name: Chi-squared
signature: Sum of k squared standard normals; special case of gamma with shape k/2, scale 2.

name: Inverse-chi-squared
signature: Reciprocal of a chi-squared variate, giving a heavy right tail and no closed-form mean for low degrees of freedom.
known_ml_uses: Bayesian conjugate prior for normal variance

name: Noncentral chi-squared
signature: Sum of squared normals with nonzero means, indexed by an extra noncentrality parameter that shifts the mode away from zero.

name: Scaled inverse chi-squared
signature: Reparameterisation of inverse-chi-squared with explicit scale parameter, standard conjugate prior for normal variance.
known_ml_uses: Bayesian hierarchical models for variance priors

name: Dagum
signature: Three-parameter distribution with a shape parameter controlling both tails, giving flexible skewness unlike the simpler Burr family it generalizes from.

name: Exponential
signature: Unique continuous memoryless distribution; maximizes entropy given a fixed mean on the positive reals.

name: Exponential-logarithmic
signature: Mixture of exponentials with a logarithmic-series mixing distribution, producing a decreasing density with heavier tail than plain exponential.

name: F
signature: Ratio of two scaled chi-squared variates; defines the null distribution for ANOVA variance-ratio tests.

name: Noncentral F
signature: Ratio involving a noncentral chi-squared numerator, used for power calculations under a non-null hypothesis unlike the central F.

name: Folded normal
signature: Absolute value of a normal random variable, producing a folded density that collapses the sign information of the parent Gaussian.

name: Frechet
signature: One of the three extreme value distribution types, arising as the limit law for maxima of heavy-tailed variables with a polynomial tail.
known_ml_uses: extreme value theory for risk/anomaly modeling

name: Gamma
signature: Two-parameter (shape, rate) family generalizing the exponential and chi-squared, conjugate prior for Poisson/exponential rate parameters.

name: Erlang
signature: Special case of gamma with integer shape k, representing the sum of k i.i.d. exponential waiting times.
known_ml_uses: survival analysis components in hazard models

name: Inverse-gamma
signature: Distribution of the reciprocal of a gamma random variable, used as conjugate prior for variance parameters.
known_ml_uses: conjugate prior in Gaussian mixture models and Bayesian neural nets

name: Generalized gamma
signature: Adds an extra power-transform parameter to the gamma distribution, unifying gamma, Weibull, and exponential as special cases.

name: Generalized Pareto
support: semi-infinite or bounded above depending on shape parameter
signature: Limiting distribution of excesses over a threshold, central to peaks-over-threshold extreme value theory.
known_ml_uses: extreme value modeling for risk estimation

name: Gamma/Gompertz
signature: Gompertz hazard mixed over a gamma-distributed frailty term, yielding a flexible mortality/hazard model.

name: Gompertz
signature: Exponentially increasing hazard rate distribution originally used for mortality curves.

name: Half-normal
signature: Folded normal distribution restricted to the non-negative half-line, obtained by taking |Z| for Z~N(0,1).

name: Hartman-Watson
signature: Distribution arising from the exponential functional of Brownian motion, notable for its intractable density expressed via modified Bessel functions and requiring specialized numerical inversion.

name: Hotelling's T-squared
signature: Multivariate generalization of the squared Student-t statistic, proportional to an F distribution and used for multivariate mean testing.

name: Inverse Gaussian
signature: Distribution of the first passage time of Brownian motion with drift, with variance function cubic in the mean.
known_ml_uses: generalized linear models (GLM) with inverse-Gaussian link

name: Levy
signature: Special stable distribution with index 1/2 and skewness 1, having no finite mean, arising as first-passage time of Brownian motion.
known_ml_uses: Levy flight exploration in stochastic optimization

name: Log-Cauchy
signature: Distribution of exp(X) where X is Cauchy, resulting in extremely heavy tails with no finite moments of any order.

name: Log-Laplace
signature: Distribution of a variable whose log follows a Laplace law, giving polynomial tails with a sharp peak at the mode unlike log-normal's smooth peak.
known_ml_uses: modeling multiplicative noise with heavy tails

name: Log-logistic
signature: Log of the variable follows a logistic distribution, giving closed-form CDF (sigmoid-like) unlike log-normal which lacks a closed-form CDF.

name: Log-metalog
signature: Metalog distribution applied to log-transformed data, parameterised directly via quantiles rather than moments, allowing highly flexible shapes without a fixed functional family.

name: Log-normal
signature: Exponential of a normal variable, giving a right-skewed distribution with closed-form moments but heavier tail than Gaussian, multiplicative rather than additive noise model.
known_ml_uses: Bayesian neural network priors on scale parameters

name: Lomax
signature: Shifted Pareto distribution (Pareto Type II) starting at zero, arising as a gamma-mixture of exponentials, giving a power-law tail with support including zero.

name: Mittag-Leffler
signature: Generalization of the exponential distribution whose Laplace transform is the Mittag-Leffler function, exhibiting power-law tails and connection to fractional calculus, unlike the exponential's light tail.
known_ml_uses: waiting-time distributions in fractional point processes

name: Nakagami
signature: Generalizes the Rayleigh distribution via a shape parameter m controlling fading severity, modeling the magnitude of a sum of squared Gaussian components.
known_ml_uses: signal amplitude modeling in communications ML

name: Pareto
signature: Pure power-law tail distribution with scale-invariance above a minimum threshold, distinguished from Lomax by not including zero in its support.
known_ml_uses: extreme value theory in anomaly detection
scaling law analysis of model performance

name: Pearson Type III
signature: Shifted/generalized gamma distribution within the Pearson system, defined by matching first three moments (skewness), used historically for hydrology and flood frequency analysis.

name: Phase-type
signature: Distribution of the absorption time of a finite continuous-time Markov chain, giving a matrix-exponential closed form that can approximate any positive distribution arbitrarily closely.
known_ml_uses: approximating arbitrary waiting-time distributions in simulation

name: Phased bi-exponential
signature: Two-phase mixture/sequence of exponential distributions with distinct rates modeling piecewise-constant hazard regimes, unlike single-rate exponential memorylessness.
known_ml_uses: survival modeling with changing hazard phases

name: Phased bi-Weibull
signature: Two-phase mixture of Weibull distributions capturing distinct early-life and wear-out failure regimes, generalizing bi-exponential by allowing varying shape within each phase.
known_ml_uses: reliability and failure-time modeling with bathtub hazard shapes

name: Semi-bounded quantile-parameterized
signature: Defined directly via a flexible quantile function anchored at a lower bound rather than via a closed-form pdf, allowing arbitrary shape matching to elicited quantiles.

name: Rayleigh
signature: Special case of Weibull with shape 2, arising as the magnitude of a 2D isotropic Gaussian vector.
known_ml_uses: modeling magnitude of complex-valued channel gains in wireless ML
speckle noise modeling in image denoising

name: Rayleigh mixture
signature: Weighted mixture of Rayleigh components giving multimodal magnitude distributions beyond the single-mode Rayleigh.
known_ml_uses: clutter modeling in radar/sonar signal processing with ML classifiers

name: Rice
signature: Generalizes Rayleigh by adding a non-centrality parameter representing a dominant line-of-sight component plus Gaussian noise.
known_ml_uses: fading channel modeling in wireless communication ML systems

name: Shifted Gompertz
signature: Product of an exponential and a Gompertz cdf, giving a distinct asymmetric hazard shape used for diffusion-of-innovation timing.

name: Type-2 Gumbel
signature: Reciprocal-type Gumbel variant with power-law right tail, unlike the light double-exponential tail of the standard Gumbel.
known_ml_uses: extreme value theory applications in risk modeling

name: Weibull
signature: Flexible hazard-rate family (increasing/decreasing/constant) generalizing exponential and Rayleigh via a shape parameter.
known_ml_uses: survival analysis / time-to-event deep learning models
weight initialization in some generative models

name: Behrens-Fisher
signature: Distribution of the difference of means of two normals with unequal unknown variances, lacking a simple closed-form density, distinct from Student-t.
known_ml_uses: Bayesian hypothesis testing of group mean differences

name: Cauchy
signature: Stable distribution with index 1 having no defined mean or variance, the ratio of two independent standard normals.
known_ml_uses: heavy-tailed noise modeling in robust regression
prior for robust Bayesian deep learning
Cauchy loss functions for outlier-robust training

name: Centralized inverse-Fano
signature: A specialized transformed/centralized variant of an inverse-Fano-type construction with no widely standardized closed form; too niche for common defining properties beyond its construction.

name: Chernoff's
signature: Limiting distribution of certain change-point / argmax statistics, defined via a specific functional of Brownian motion rather than a simple closed pdf.

name: Exponentially modified Gaussian
signature: Convolution of a Gaussian and an exponential, producing a right-skewed bell shape with an exponential tail on one side, unlike the symmetric Gaussian.
known_ml_uses: reaction-time modeling in cognitive science ML
latency distribution modeling in systems ML

name: Gaussian minus exponential
signature: Convolution of a Gaussian and a negated exponential, giving an exponentially-modified-Gaussian-like skewed density with one exponential tail.
known_ml_uses: modeling reaction-time or residual distributions with skew

name: Expectile
signature: Defined via asymmetric squared-loss minimization rather than absolute-loss, giving a mean-like generalization of quantiles.
known_ml_uses: distributional reinforcement learning (expectile losses in IQL)

name: Fisher-Tippett
support: whole real line (or bounded depending on type)
signature: General name for the three extreme value distribution types (Gumbel, Frechet, Weibull) arising as limit laws of block maxima.
known_ml_uses: extreme value theory in anomaly detection

name: Extreme value
support: whole real line (type I) or bounded/half-line (types II/III)
signature: Limit distribution of normalized maxima of iid samples, unifying Gumbel/Frechet/Weibull as one family via the extreme value index.
known_ml_uses: extreme value theory for anomaly/outlier detection

name: Log-Weibull
signature: Equivalent to the Gumbel distribution, obtained as the log-transform of a Weibull-distributed variable.

name: Fisher's z
signature: Distribution of half the log-ratio of two independent chi-squared variables scaled by degrees of freedom, underlying the F-distribution via exponential transform.
known_ml_uses: classical statistical hypothesis testing (rarely used directly in ML)

name: Skewed generalized t
signature: Four-parameter family nesting Student-t, normal, and skewed variants via separate skew and tail-thickness parameters, more flexible than a plain Student-t.
known_ml_uses: robust regression with heavy-tailed/skewed noise models

name: Gamma-difference
signature: Distribution of the difference of two independent Gamma random variables, a signed generalization of the Laplace distribution (Bessel-function density).

name: Generalized logistic
signature: Adds a shape parameter to the logistic distribution to allow skewness while preserving a sigmoid-like CDF form.

name: Generalized normal
signature: Exponential power family with a shape parameter beta interpolating between Laplace (beta=1) and Gaussian (beta=2) and approaching uniform as beta to infinity.
known_ml_uses: generalized Gaussian priors for sparse coding

name: Geometric stable
signature: Stable law arising as the limit of geometric random sums (random number of terms is geometric), giving heavier tails than ordinary stable sums.

name: Gumbel
signature: Type I extreme value distribution for block maxima with exponential tail decay, characterized by a double-exponential CDF.

name: Holtsmark
signature: Symmetric stable distribution with characteristic exponent alpha=3/2, arising from gravitational field fluctuations in random star distributions, unlike Gaussian or Cauchy which are alpha=2 and alpha=1 cases.

name: Hyperbolic
signature: Log-density is a hyperbola rather than a parabola (as in Gaussian), giving semi-heavy exponential tails and arising as a normal variance-mean mixture with Generalized Inverse Gaussian mixing distribution.
known_ml_uses: financial return modeling with heavy tails

name: Hyperbolic secant
signature: Symmetric bell-shaped distribution whose density and characteristic function are both proportional to hyperbolic secant, self-reciprocal under the Fourier transform unlike the Gaussian's self-reciprocity being exact identity.
known_ml_uses: activation function shape references (sech^2 relates to tanh derivative)

name: Johnson SU
signature: Defined via a hyperbolic-sine transformation of a normal variable, giving four parameters that flexibly control skewness and kurtosis unlike the fixed-shape Gaussian.
known_ml_uses: flexible output distribution heads for regression with skew/kurtosis

name: Landau
signature: Describes energy loss fluctuations of charged particles via ionization, with a distinctive asymmetric shape and a tail heavier than Gaussian but not a standard stable index, no closed-form moments.

name: Laplace
signature: Two-sided exponential decay giving a sharp peak at the mean and heavier-than-Gaussian tails, maximizing entropy subject to a fixed mean absolute deviation.
known_ml_uses: L1 regularization as MAP under Laplace prior

name: Levy skew alpha-stable
signature: General four-parameter stable family with skewness parameter beta, characterized by closure under convolution up to scale/location shifts and no closed-form density except for special cases.
known_ml_uses: modeling heavy-tailed noise/gradients in stochastic optimization theory

name: Stable
signature: Whole family of distributions closed under linear combinations of i.i.d. copies (Gaussian, Cauchy, Levy as special cases), indexed by stability parameter alpha in (0,2].
known_ml_uses: theoretical analysis of heavy-tailed SGD noise

name: Linnik
signature: Symmetric distribution with characteristic function 1/(1+|t|^alpha), giving power-law tails while being geometric-stable rather than ordinary-stable like the Linnik's cousin the Laplace (alpha=2 case).

name: Logistic
signature: Symmetric bell-shaped distribution whose CDF is the sigmoid function, distinguished from Gaussian by heavier tails and closed-form CDF/quantile function.

name: Map-Airy
signature: Distribution of the rescaled maximum related to the Airy process, appearing as a limit law in random matrix theory and last-passage percolation, distinct from the Tracy-Widom laws it relates to.

name: Metalog
signature: Defined directly by its quantile function as a flexible polynomial expansion in log-odds of the cumulative probability, allowing near-arbitrary shape fitting without assuming a fixed parametric family.

name: Normal
signature: The maximum-entropy distribution for fixed mean and variance, stable under convolution with index 2.
known_ml_uses: VAE latent priors and reparameterisation trick

name: Normal-exponential-gamma
signature: A normal variance-mixture with an exponential-gamma mixing distribution, giving sparsity-inducing heavy tails used as a Bayesian shrinkage prior.

name: Normal-inverse Gaussian
signature: Normal variance-mixture with inverse Gaussian mixing distribution, infinitely divisible and closed under convolution for fixed shape/skew ratio.
known_ml_uses: heavy-tailed noise models in generative modeling

name: Pearson Type IV
signature: A skewed, heavy-tailed member of the Pearson family defined by a differential equation for the density, generalizing Student's t with asymmetric tails.

name: Skew normal
signature: Normal density multiplied by a skewing factor via a shape parameter, reducing to the normal at zero skew.
known_ml_uses: flexible generative modeling of asymmetric noise

name: Student's t
signature: A normal-gamma variance mixture with heavier-than-Gaussian polynomial tails controlled by degrees-of-freedom, reducing to Normal as df to infinity.

name: Noncentral t
signature: Student's t generalized by a noncentrality parameter shifting the ratio's numerator, used for power calculations under nonzero-mean alternatives.

name: Skew t
signature: Student's t further skewed by a shape parameter, combining heavy tails with asymmetry, nesting both skew-normal and t as limits.
known_ml_uses: robust asymmetric noise modeling in Bayesian models

name: Champernowne
support: whole real line (log-Champernowne) or positive reals
signature: A distribution originally designed to model income with a logistic-like closed-form CDF exhibiting power-law tails.

name: Type-1 Gumbel
signature: The limiting extreme-value distribution for maxima of light-tailed variables, with double-exponential CDF form.

name: Tracy-Widom
signature: The limiting distribution of the largest eigenvalue of large random Hermitian matrices, with no simple closed form (Painlevé II based).
known_ml_uses: random matrix theory analysis of neural network Hessians/weight spectra

name: Voigt
signature: The convolution of a Gaussian and a Cauchy (Lorentzian) distribution, combining Doppler and pressure broadening effects.
known_ml_uses: spectral line-shape fitting in physics-informed ML

name: Chen
signature: Bathtub-shaped or increasing hazard function distribution with closed-form CDF exp(1-exp(x^b))-type form, used for reliability/lifetime modeling.

name: Generalized extreme value
support: variable, depends on shape parameter (bounded or half-line or full line)
signature: Unifies Gumbel, Frechet, and Weibull extreme-value families via a single shape parameter controlling tail behavior.
known_ml_uses: extreme value theory for anomaly/outlier modeling
risk and tail modeling in generative models

name: Tukey lambda
support: variable, typically bounded interval depending on lambda
signature: Defined purely via its quantile function (no closed-form density in general), enabling flexible symmetric shape interpolation between distributions.

name: Wakeby
support: variable, typically positive reals or bounded below
signature: Five-parameter distribution defined only through its quantile function, allowing flexible tail and skewness control for hydrological extremes.

name: Rectified Gaussian
support: non-negative reals with point mass at zero
signature: Gaussian distribution with negative mass collapsed to a point mass at zero, mimicking ReLU activation statistics.

name: Compound Poisson-gamma
support: non-negative reals with point mass at zero
signature: Poisson-distributed number of gamma-distributed jumps summed, producing exact zero mass plus continuous positive density.

name: Tweedie
support: non-negative reals (or full line depending on power parameter)
signature: Exponential dispersion family unifying Poisson, gamma, and compound Poisson-gamma via a single power parameter linking mean-variance relation.
known_ml_uses: GLM loss functions for zero-inflated regression

name: Dirichlet
signature: Conjugate prior to the categorical/multinomial with concentration parameters directly controlling sparsity toward simplex boundary.

name: Ewens's sampling formula
support: partitions of integers / discrete combinatorial structures
signature: Distribution over integer partitions arising from a single mutation-parameter Chinese restaurant process, unique in giving exchangeable random partitions.

name: Balding-Nichols
support: unit interval per allele frequency, jointly over populations
signature: Beta-distributed allele frequencies parameterized by population differentiation (Fst), modeling correlated subpopulation drift from an ancestral frequency.

name: Multinomial
support: non-negative integer vectors summing to n
signature: Joint distribution of counts across k categories from n independent categorical draws, generalizing the binomial to multiple outcomes.
known_ml_uses: categorical sampling in language model heads

name: Multivariate normal
signature: Fully characterized by mean vector and covariance matrix, unique as the maximum-entropy distribution given fixed first two moments in R^n.

name: Multivariate t
signature: Gaussian scale-mixture with inverse-gamma mixing giving heavier tails and an extra degrees-of-freedom parameter controlling kurtosis

name: Negative multinomial
signature: multivariate generalization of the negative binomial counting failures across categories before a fixed number of successes, inducing positive correlation among counts

name: Dirichlet negative multinomial
signature: negative multinomial with Dirichlet-mixed success probabilities, giving an extra layer of overdispersion beyond the negative multinomial

name: Generalized multivariate log-gamma
signature: constructed via log-transformed gamma variables with a shared correlation structure, generalizing univariate log-gamma to multivariate dependence

name: Marshall-Olkin exponential
signature: constructed from shared and idiosyncratic shock processes so marginals stay exponential (memoryless) while inducing dependence via common shocks

name: Continuous-categorical
signature: continuous analogue of the categorical distribution on the simplex with closed-form normalizing constant, distinct from Dirichlet in its density form
known_ml_uses: continuous relaxation of categorical variables for variational inference

name: Wishart
signature: distribution of scatter matrices from multivariate Gaussian samples, conjugate prior for precision matrix in Gaussian models

name: Inverse-Wishart
signature: conjugate prior for the covariance matrix (rather than precision) of a multivariate Gaussian, inverse of Wishart-distributed matrix

name: Lewandowski-Kurowicka-Joe
signature: prior directly on correlation matrices via onion-peeling construction with a single shape parameter controlling concentration around identity
known_ml_uses: probabilistic programming priors (Stan/PyMC) for correlation matrices

name: Matrix normal
signature: Gaussian over matrices factorized into separate row and column covariance matrices, equivalent to a multivariate normal with Kronecker-structured covariance

name: Matrix t
signature: matrix-variate generalization of multivariate t obtained by scale-mixing matrix normal with inverse-Wishart, giving heavier tails than matrix normal

name: Matrix Langevin
signature: matrix-variate von Mises-Fisher distribution on the Stiefel manifold, maximizing entropy given a matrix mean parameter constraint
known_ml_uses: orientation estimation in geometric deep learning

name: Matrix variate beta
support: pairs of symmetric positive semi-definite matrices with eigenvalues in [0,1] (or matrix intervals)
signature: Generalizes the univariate beta to matrices via ratios of independent Wishart matrices, giving a matrix-valued density on positive semi-definite cone.
known_ml_uses: random matrix theory analysis of covariance estimators
priors for covariance/correlation matrices in Bayesian models

name: Uniform on a Stiefel manifold
support: set of orthonormal k-frames in R^n (Stiefel manifold V_k(R^n))
signature: Uniform distribution over orthonormal matrix frames, invariant under orthogonal group action, unlike Gaussian-derived matrix variate distributions.
known_ml_uses: random orthogonal initialization of weight matrices

name: Categorical
support: finite set of K discrete unordered categories
signature: Generalizes the Bernoulli to K outcomes with probabilities summing to 1 on the simplex, with no ordinal structure.

name: Cantor
support: Cantor set, a fractal subset of [0,1] with Lebesgue measure zero
signature: A continuous singular distribution with no density, no atoms, yet supported on a measure-zero fractal set, unlike absolutely continuous or discrete distributions.

name: Pearson family
support: varies by member (real line or subintervals, depending on parameterization)
signature: A family of distributions defined by a common differential equation for the density parameterized by the first four moments, unifying normal, beta, gamma, and t distributions as special cases.
